title: PNP backs Lacson: Secrecy key in hunt for Bato dela Rosa
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) agrees with Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson that secrecy is key when handling the manhunt operation on Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) agrees with Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson that secrecy is key when handling the manhunt operation on Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa. “Tama ang sinabi ni Sen. Lacson na secrecy is key in our operation,” PNP spokesperson Col. Allen Rae Co told reporters on Tuesday. (Sen. Lacson was right when he said that secrecy is key to our operations) “We do not expound on what we are doing. Ito ay operations, meron tayong tinatawag na operations secrecy (These are operations, and we have what we call operational secrecy),” Co added. Read: Lacson cautions vs […]...
